correctness.rationale: Direct all-subset domination criterion for once-subdivided K_n gives exhaustive inclusion-minimal sets U and D_R. At k=n-1 all D_pairs are isolated; at k=n the union of distinct pairs needs at least n+1 vertices, hence no mergers. For k>=n+1 every D_R of size below k reaches U through the explicit add-original/delete-incident-edges sequence, and all size-k minimal states are isolated. The b_r values are strictly increasing from r>=2; this proves exact component counts. Independent finite brute-force checker exhaustively verified n=2..5 and every tested budget, but is not substituted for infinite proof.
